style: Space and planet imagery for a space game: planet surface maps, clouds, nebula, planetary rings and the sun. Each cell is a flat texture that fills the whole cell.

cells.name: sky-earth
cells.prompt: Whole planet Earth as an equirectangular map stretched to fill the square: real continents in their real positions, deep blue oceans, green and brown land, white polar ice at the top and bottom edges, no clouds.

cells.name: sky-desert
cells.prompt: Rusty red-orange desert planet surface seen from orbit: canyons, craters, dune fields and dark basalt plains.

cells.name: sky-ice
cells.prompt: Icy moon surface seen from orbit: blue-white ice sheets with long cracks, ridges and pressure bands.

cells.name: sky-lava
cells.prompt: Volcanic planet surface seen from orbit: black cooled crust broken by glowing orange-red lava rivers and cracks.

cells.name: sky-gas
cells.prompt: Gas giant cloud bands as an equirectangular map: horizontal cream, orange and brown bands with swirling storms and one large oval storm.

cells.name: sky-clouds
cells.prompt: White cloud formations seen from above on a pure black background, swirling patches with clear gaps.

cells.name: sky-nebula
cells.prompt: Deep-space nebula: wispy blue and teal gas clouds with scattered stars on black.

cells.name: sky-rings
cells.prompt: Planetary ring material seen edge-on as thin horizontal bands of beige, grey and brown, straight lines across the whole cell.

cells.name: sky-sun
cells.prompt: Close-up of the solar surface: bright orange-yellow plasma granulation cells and darker lanes.
